people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Ur
people.line: The hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia

translations.web: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
translations.bsb: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.
translations.kjv: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
translations.asv: Thou art Jehovah the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham,
